old_behavior: Older trees provide behavioral references.
newer_behavior: v3.9.6 remains the only implementation baseline; older code is merged selectively.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Prevents wholesale downgrade while allowing safer/correct behavior recovery.
safety_comparison: Newer safety boundaries win unless an older implementation is demonstrably stricter.
evidence_quality_comparison: Every merge is tied to a focused offline test and decision record.
compatibility_impact: No public path is replaced wholesale.
residual_risk: Undocumented external consumers may depend on private internals not visible in supplied archives.

old_behavior: Synthetic DEBUG override; plain 405 must not confirm.
newer_behavior: Same-request GET control plus explicit DEBUG-context or status differential.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Strengthened the old false-positive fix with a direct control.
safety_comparison: Non-destructive fake method only; no state-changing method is sent.
evidence_quality_comparison: Requires meaningful response evidence, not status alone.
compatibility_impact: Same function and return tuple retained.
residual_risk: Some frameworks normalize both control and override responses, producing an intentional false negative rather than an unsafe false positive.

old_behavior: GET probes with body signatures.
newer_behavior: Adds random same-host control, content-type filtering and distinctive-body checks.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Generic SPA/soft-404 HTML no longer confirms .env or .git/config exposure.
safety_comparison: Read-only GET requests, throttled and timed out.
evidence_quality_comparison: Body signature and control differential are stored in the reproducer evidence.
compatibility_impact: Same public function retained.
residual_risk: Highly customized raw-file renderers may require manual review.

old_behavior: Header routing probe looked only at the injected response.
newer_behavior: Direct /admin control is compared with the header-routed request.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Eliminates root-dashboard false positives and requires access-control differential.
safety_comparison: Read-only request; localhost forwarding header removed from the bypass claim.
evidence_quality_comparison: Admin-specific content plus denied/absent direct control is required.
compatibility_impact: Same function and output contract retained.
residual_risk: Reverse proxies that intentionally mask direct responses may still need manual confirmation.

old_behavior: Bounded overlapping Range header indicator.
newer_behavior: Retained as a 20-range, read-only indicator with timeout and qualified language.
identified_regression_or_improvement: No destructive denial-of-service workload added.
safety_comparison: Safe bounded request only.
evidence_quality_comparison: 206 is a lead requiring manual safe retest, not proof of service exhaustion.
compatibility_impact: Same function retained.
residual_risk: 206 may be standards-compliant on some servers; report language remains qualified.

old_behavior: Known paths and bounded self-healing update.
newer_behavior: Common paths retained; only structurally valid YAML is counted; nonzero update exits are reported.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Malformed or empty stores can no longer be reported healthy.
safety_comparison: Updates are explicit, bounded and only attempted when nuclei exists and store is below threshold.
evidence_quality_comparison: stderr/exit code and post-update valid count determine result.
compatibility_impact: Existing functions and return keys preserved; error field is additive.
residual_risk: Template schemas evolve; structural validation intentionally checks mandatory fields rather than every Nuclei schema rule.

old_behavior: Absolute workflow directory with tag fallback.
newer_behavior: Retained unchanged when valid workflows exist; tags used when absent.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Avoids silent no-template runs caused by fragile relative paths.
safety_comparison: No workflow execution during tests.
evidence_quality_comparison: Resolved command arguments reveal whether workflow or tag coverage was used.
compatibility_impact: Same helper retained.
residual_risk: Installed templates may omit expected technology workflows; tag fallback provides partial coverage only.

old_behavior: Go semantic-import suffixes and ProjectDiscovery httpx identity handling.
newer_behavior: Retained and regression-checked; no privileged pip install added.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Prevents false detection of binaries named v2/v3 or unrelated Python httpx.
safety_comparison: Installation remains explicit; optional failures degrade gracefully.
evidence_quality_comparison: Tool version output is used for identity validation.
compatibility_impact: Shell function behavior retained.
residual_risk: Installer still depends on external package managers and network availability when the operator invokes it.

old_behavior: Random-path, status, body, length, redirect and JSON-code controls.
newer_behavior: Retained and tested across wildcard 200, custom 404, redirect and JSON catch-all fixtures.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Prevents status-200-only endpoint confirmation.
safety_comparison: At most a small bounded number of control requests; shared rate limiter remains authoritative.
evidence_quality_comparison: Differential evidence is required to classify an endpoint as distinct.
compatibility_impact: Public helpers retained.
residual_risk: Dynamic pages with highly variable bodies may need manual baselining.

newer_path_and_symbol: same paths plus later enrichment phases
old_behavior: Source/mobile/SBOM/API/GraphQL/WebSocket/SSE/PWA/CNAME/safe-smuggling discovery.
newer_behavior: All historical paths remain; newer confirmation model keeps static results as leads.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Newer implementation is a functional and safety superset.
safety_comparison: No static observation self-confirms; active checks remain scope- and profile-gated.
evidence_quality_comparison: Reachability, provenance and evidence strength are separated.
compatibility_impact: All v3.9.6 paths and phase names retained.
residual_risk: Optional external analyzers may be unavailable and are reported as coverage gaps.

old_path_and_symbol: core/reporter.py legacy branch helpers and governance phases
old_behavior: Branch matrix, objective map, approval register, safe-write policy and conservative status language.
newer_behavior: Structured governance architecture retained with compatibility helpers restored.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Detailed branch table had disappeared from newer report output and is restored.
safety_comparison: Not Tested is never rendered Safe; absence of findings is not a pass.
evidence_quality_comparison: Coverage status references actual phase/finding evidence.
compatibility_impact: Legacy helper names restored where externally callable.
residual_risk: Automated branch mapping remains partial and requires human review.

newer_path_and_symbol: same paths and current phase graph
old_behavior: Opt-in SQLi, read-only AD, service primitive and code-intelligence add-ons.
newer_behavior: Preserved as opt-in/local-only or approval-controlled paths.
identified_regression_or_improvement: No historical add-on becomes active by default.
safety_comparison: Write-capable or sensitive actions remain disabled/external.
evidence_quality_comparison: Add-on outputs flow through evidence manifests as leads unless confirmed separately.
compatibility_impact: Paths, imports and phase names retained.
residual_risk: Third-party tool/API availability remains environment-dependent.

old_behavior: Path/test/doc/placeholder/entropy suppression and runtime proof parsing.
newer_behavior: Five-level evidence distinction is retained: observation, reachable observation, supported, reproduced, confirmed.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Static traces cannot confirm themselves.
safety_comparison: Live validation is authorization-gated and bounded.
evidence_quality_comparison: Confirmation basis, negative controls and provenance are report fields.
compatibility_impact: Existing status keys retained with additive fields.
residual_risk: Business-logic confirmation still requires suitable test accounts and manual judgment.

old_behavior: Tool-specific recursive generic parser.
newer_behavior: Shared JSON/JSONL/SARIF normalizer with bounded recursion, deduplication, CWE, location and provenance preservation.
identified_regression_or_improvement: The shared implementation is stricter and avoids duplicate SARIF parsing.
safety_comparison: Imported records remain leads; malformed input is ignored safely.
evidence_quality_comparison: Source, rule, file, line, CWE and raw record provenance are retained.
compatibility_impact: sev/walk wrappers retained for import compatibility; shared normalizer is preferred.
residual_risk: Highly proprietary scanner formats may need an explicit reviewed adapter.

newer_path_and_symbol: core/reporter.py compatibility helpers plus structured renderers
old_behavior: Legacy private helpers produced audience summaries and HTML.
newer_behavior: Modern structured report remains authoritative; helper names restored as wrappers/compatible implementations.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Avoids blindly reverting to the old reporter while preserving callable surfaces.
safety_comparison: Report language remains evidence-bounded and redacted.
evidence_quality_comparison: All confirmation fields and per-finding kits are generated from normalized assessments.
compatibility_impact: Legacy names and old REPORT.html path preserved.
residual_risk: Private-helper consumers outside the supplied tree may still rely on undocumented exact formatting.

newer_path_and_symbol: lowercase canonical outputs plus uppercase compatibility writers
old_behavior: Machine-readable and multi-audience reports evolved across releases.
newer_behavior: Both lowercase current names and uppercase compatibility names are written deterministically.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Restores REPORT.json, REPORT.csv and REPORT.sarif consumers without removing current paths.
safety_comparison: No finding is upgraded by export.
evidence_quality_comparison: Exports preserve evidence references, confirmation, confidence and provenance.
compatibility_impact: Additive aliases; no old path removed.
residual_risk: Duplicate aliases consume modest disk space by design.

old_behavior: Dependency-free strings/import/JSON fallback.
newer_behavior: Modern five-stage workflow is primary; bounded dependency-free fallback and legacy wrappers are retained.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Short dangerous APIs, canonical hashes, valid IPs, secret redaction and bounded reads are improved.
safety_comparison: No target artifact is executed.
evidence_quality_comparison: Canonical artifact ID and per-binary metadata correlate all stages; capa/imported output stays non-confirming.
compatibility_impact: Legacy helper names and evidence directories supported.
residual_risk: Packed/encrypted binaries and unsupported formats require external manual analysis.

old_behavior: Profiles could place OSINT before preflight or Web3 after report finalization.
newer_behavior: All profile subsets are canonicalized against one graph; preflight first and evidence_finalize last.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Corrects orchestration regressions without deleting explicit operator phase overrides.
safety_comparison: Safety preflight precedes operational phases.
evidence_quality_comparison: Report/finalization cannot precede optional operational phases in canonical profiles.
compatibility_impact: All old phase identifiers retained; five real opt-in phases added.
residual_risk: Explicit --phases remains intentionally operator-controlled and may choose a custom subset.

old_behavior: Capabilities were inferred from phases and documentation.
newer_behavior: Central registry declares native/adapter/import/proposal/planned/unavailable state and requirements.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Prevents planned or unavailable functions from being presented as operational.
safety_comparison: Approval, network and safety classes are explicit.
evidence_quality_comparison: Status command reports exact availability reasons and dependencies.
compatibility_impact: Existing phases remain; registry is additive.
residual_risk: Registry metadata must be updated when integrations change.

old_behavior: Checks were distributed and focused mainly on scan tooling.
newer_behavior: Unified truthful environment, policy, evidence-store, package, executable and secret-presence checks.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Missing optional dependencies no longer imply global failure.
safety_comparison: Secret values are never printed; service probes are opt-in.
evidence_quality_comparison: Every failed check includes a reason/remediation.
compatibility_impact: Additive management command; old diagnostics retained.
residual_risk: Service reachability is not checked unless explicitly requested.

old_behavior: Plans were generated but not natively executable.
newer_behavior: Only RDAP, Sherlock, Maigret and local cosign verify-blob are allowlisted with structured arguments.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Adds real capability without arbitrary command execution.
safety_comparison: Unknown actions, shell fields, metacharacters and unapproved actions are rejected; shell=False.
evidence_quality_comparison: Timestamps, exit code, version, stdout/stderr and provenance are recorded.
compatibility_impact: Opt-in phase; no old behavior removed.
residual_risk: External tools may change CLI syntax; failures are captured honestly.

old_behavior: No normalized dedicated session/beacon importer.
newer_behavior: JSON/CSV import-only tracker with validation, deterministic IDs and deduplication.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Adds reporting depth without C2 startup, payload generation or control.
safety_comparison: Import-only safety class.
evidence_quality_comparison: Every record retains source/provenance and malformed records are counted.
compatibility_impact: Additive opt-in phase.
residual_risk: Vendor-specific fields outside the normalized schema remain in raw provenance only where safe.

old_behavior: Mixed external tools and proposal-only provider coverage.
newer_behavior: Provider framework with one genuinely implemented native RDAP collector; other providers are not falsely advertised.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Adds bounded retry, rate, timeout, PII policy, redaction and offline transport fixtures.
safety_comparison: No real service calls occur in tests; credentials are presence-checked only.
evidence_quality_comparison: Provider errors and provenance are normalized.
compatibility_impact: Additive opt-in capability.
residual_risk: Only RDAP is native in this release; additional APIs require reviewed implementations.

old_behavior: Permission-name indicators and limited normalized paths.
newer_behavior: AWS/Azure/GCP/generic graph import with evidence-backed paths and compatibility output.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Restores CreateAccessKey and Azure Application Administrator indicators while avoiding exploitability claims.
safety_comparison: Read-only import/analyze only.
evidence_quality_comparison: Paths list prerequisites, uncertainty and source evidence.
compatibility_impact: cloud_identity_paths.json and legacy helper behavior retained.
residual_risk: Provider exports vary; partially recognized data is imported generically with lower confidence.

old_behavior: Some summaries could imply coverage from tool execution.
newer_behavior: Control predicates evaluate actual evidence with pass/fail/unknown/not_applicable/not_tested.
identified_regression_or_improvement: A scanner run alone cannot produce pass.
safety_comparison: Read-only evidence evaluation.
evidence_quality_comparison: Reason, confidence, evaluator version and references are mandatory.
compatibility_impact: Existing mappings and output keys retained.
residual_risk: Control mappings remain advisory and require assessor review for formal certification.

old_behavior: Workflow checks and optional external tool summaries.
newer_behavior: Native trust/dataflow analysis plus honest actionlint/zizmor/cosign availability.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Untrusted sources reaching shell and risky trust boundaries are modeled without command execution.
safety_comparison: Workflow commands are parsed only, never executed.
evidence_quality_comparison: Findings include source, sink, path, permissions and uncertainty.
compatibility_impact: Legacy summary keys retained.
residual_risk: Complex reusable workflows and generated YAML may require manual graph expansion.

old_behavior: Generic event normalization and earlier field names.
newer_behavior: Class-aware export with stable fingerprints excluding volatile fields; old fields retained.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Same logical event receives the same fingerprint across order/time changes.
safety_comparison: Export cannot change finding confirmation.
evidence_quality_comparison: Original evidence reference and observable/finding IDs are preserved.
compatibility_impact: Legacy _fingerprint/vulnerabilities/unmapped compatibility retained.
residual_risk: OCSF coverage is intentionally subset-based; unknown mappings are explicit.

old_behavior: No dedicated normalized passive wireless observation importer.
newer_behavior: SSID/BSSID/channel/frequency/encryption/signal/vendor/time/source/location-label import only.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Adds passive inventory without capture, deauthentication, cracking or impersonation.
safety_comparison: Observational/import-only.
evidence_quality_comparison: Deterministic observations retain source and risk notes.
compatibility_impact: Additive opt-in phase.
residual_risk: Vendor resolution is local/best-effort and location labels are user supplied.

old_behavior: Adapters were manually authored or cataloged.
newer_behavior: Generator emits unapproved proposal metadata, parser/test/doc skeleton descriptions and risk classification.
identified_regression_or_improvement: Generated content cannot auto-install, activate or execute.
safety_comparison: Proposal-only state and human review are mandatory.
evidence_quality_comparison: Proposal includes explicit implementation state and review status.
compatibility_impact: Additive opt-in phase.
residual_risk: Human reviewers remain responsible for validating commands and parsers before implementation.
